```{r setup}
library(forestData)
library(googledrive)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(reproducible)
library(RPostgres)
```

## Using previously exported CASFRI data

```{r, eval = FALSE}
## ensure you are working with enough temp scratch storage space!
dataPath <- "~/data/CASFRI/v5/Ontario"
scratchPath <- ifelse(nzchar(Sys.getenv("SCRATCHDIR")), Sys.getenv("SCRATCHDIR"), tempdir())

options(
  reproducible.cachePath = file.path(scratchPath, "cache"),
  reproducible.useTerra = TRUE
)

terraOptions(
  memfrac = 0.2,
  tempdir = scratchPath
)

## access CASFRI ROF files on Google Drive
drive_auth()
driveFiles <- drive_ls(as_id("1E8YjNA8AEt2J44R5z7jz1x799jU1X1J6"))
lapply(driveFiles, drive_download, path = dataPath)

casfriFiles <- list(
  geo = file.path(dataPath, "CEON_ROF_casfri.gdb"), ## geometry attributes
  hdr = file.path(dataPath, "CEON_ROF_hdr.csv"),    ## header attributes
  cas = file.path(dataPath, "CEON_ROF_cas.csv"),    ## CAS base polygon attributes
  eco = file.path(dataPath, "CEON_ROF_eco.csv"),    ## ecological specific attributes
  dst = file.path(dataPath, "CEON_ROF_dst.csv"),    ## disturbance history attributes
  lyr = file.path(dataPath, "CEON_ROF_lyr.csv"),    ## forest-level attributes
  nfl = file.path(dataPath, "CEON_ROF_nfl.csv")     ## non-forest land attributes
)

CAN <- geodata::gadm("CAN", path = scratchPath) |> st_as_sf()
ON <- CAN[CAN$NAME_1 == "Ontario", ]

ROF <- prepInputs(
  url = "https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DzVRglqJNvZA8NZZ7XKe3-6Q5f8tlydQ",
  targetFile = "ROF_RA_def.shp", alsoExtract = "similar",
  fun = "sf::st_read", destinationPath = scratchPath,
  filename2 = "ROF_RA_def", overwrite = TRUE
)

templateRaster <- Cache({
  ntemsAge(scratchPath, studyArea = ROF)
})

casfri_sf <- Cache({
  casfriSpeciesCover(casfriFiles) ## don't need studyArea here b/c data already subset to ROF
})

casfri_rst <- Cache({
  casfriSpeciesLayers(casfri_sf, templateRaster)
})
```
